scientific_integrity: Complete algebraic proof plus finite independent standard-library numerical substitutions; no finite sample presented as proof of exhaustiveness.
scientific_limitations: Exact period-two orbit count only for 2x2 reflection-symmetric positive-definite Hessians with 0<b<a, 0<beta<1, epsilon-outside RMSProp and no bias correction; does not establish Floquet stability or any classification of higher cycles. Independent mathematical and priority validation have not been performed.
title: A complete four-regime period-two census for symmetric coupled RMSProp
